summary: Describes how an IPv4 host can configure an address for itself automatically when no DHCP server or manual setup is available. The host picks an address from a reserved link-local range and checks that nobody else on the link uses it, which gives a usable subset of networking on a local link.

eli5.summary: When nobody hands out house numbers, each house picks one for itself and asks the neighbors whether it is taken. That lets everyone on one street still find each other.

questions: automatic ip address configuration without dhcp
